propositions: pip-audit gate fails on every patchset against main due to PYSEC-2026-2132 (command injection in click.edit) advisory on click 8.2.1, blocking Verified +1 votes
click 8.2.1 cannot be upgraded to 8.3.3+ via normal lock refresh because inspect-ai (via [eval] extra) caps click at <8.2.2 and uv resolves all extras jointly
The cap is stale: inspect-ai 0.3.251 imports cleanly and runs under click 8.4.2, proving the restriction is no longer enforced by upstream
override-dependencies = ["click>=8.3.3"] in pyproject.toml enables uv to resolve click 8.4.2 without breaking inspect-ai, clearing the advisory while remaining a workspace-only directive
The fix landed on main as commit 31844d5f9fb with changes to pyproject.toml and uv.lock; pip-audit now passes with no known vulnerabilities found
